summary: Sporting News columnist Nick Brinkerhoff offers Week 14 NFL DFS advice for DraftKings GPP tournaments on the Sunday main slate with a $50,000 budget, picking players at each position with salaries and matchup reasoning. He builds around a Justin Fields-DJ Moore Bears stack, splurges on Christian McCaffrey and Alvin Kamara, and picks cheap upside plays and the Texans defense against the Jets. The article also lists a SuperDraft lineup that uses point multipliers instead of salaries.
one_line: Sporting News gives Week 14 DraftKings and SuperDraft NFL DFS lineup picks, stacking Bears QB Justin Fields with DJ Moore and splurging on McCaffrey and Kamara.
key_facts: DraftKings scoring rules: full-point PPR, four-point passing TDs, and three-point bonuses for 100 rushing yards, 100 receiving yards, and 300 passing yards.
The DraftKings Week 14 lineup is built for the Sunday main slate with a $50,000 budget.
QB Justin Fields (Bears vs. Lions, $6,800) rushed for 104 yards and threw a touchdown against Detroit in Week 11.
RB Christian McCaffrey (49ers vs. Seahawks, $9,200) rushed for over 100 yards and two touchdowns against the Seahawks two weeks earlier.
RB Alvin Kamara (Saints vs. Panthers, $8,200) is projected for at least 100 total yards and a touchdown; Derek Carr will likely be out with a concussion, leaving Jameis Winston to start.
WR DJ Moore (Bears vs. Lions, $6,500) has 210 yards and a TD over the past two games and scored almost 23 fantasy points against the Lions in Week 12.
WR Drake London (Falcons vs. Buccaneers, $4,600) caught six of seven targets for 54 yards against Tampa in Week 7.
WR Jaxon Smith-Njigba (Seahawks @ 49ers, $4,100) had seven catches on 11 targets for 62 yards against the Cowboys, while Tyler Lockett's involvement is lessening.

TE Brevin Jordan (Texans @ Jets, $3,100) caught three of four targets for 64 yards against the Broncos after Dalton Schultz left with a hamstring injury; if Schultz plays, the pivot is Jets TE Tyler Conklin, $100 cheaper.
FLEX Jameson Williams (Lions @ Bears, $3,500) has delivered a big play in two of the past three weeks.
The Texans DEF ($4,000) at the Jets is picked because the Jets offense is trusted to score fewer than 10 points, with Zach Wilson reportedly reluctant to play.
SuperDraft uses point multipliers instead of salaries, with half-point PPR and two-point bonuses for 100 rushing yards, 100 receiving yards, and 300 passing yards.
The SuperDraft lineup: Fields (1.2x), McCaffrey (1x), Joe Mixon (1.3x), Moore (1.25x), Michael Pittman Jr. (1.2x), Mike Evans (1.1x), Gerald Everett (1.6x, TE), and Kamara (1.1x, FLEX).
